intent.raw_query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA

experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Begin your mornings with a guided yoga session at the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud. This serene hilltop setting offers panoramic views of lush jungle valleys, making it an ideal spot for mindful practice. Since the flight arrives late on Day 1, this is best scheduled from Day 2 onward. Many local instructors offer small-group sessions right on the ridge at dawn, combining gentle movement with breathtaking natural scenery. Walking distance from central Ubud hotels keeps travel time minimal.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset & Surf Lesson
experiences.description: Spend an afternoon at Seminyak Beach, one of Bali's most accessible and vibrant stretches of coastline. Take a beginner-friendly surf lesson with a certified local instructor in the early afternoon when waves are consistent, then relax and watch the legendary Bali sunset from the shore. Seminyak is a central hub with hotels, cafes, and beach clubs within walking distance, making it easy to reach even after a late arrival the night before. Budget-friendly warungs along the beach serve fresh coconut and local snacks.

experiences.name: Tegallalang Rice Terrace Walk & Balinese Cooking Class
experiences.description: Explore the UNESCO-recognized Tegallalang Rice Terraces on a guided morning walk, learning about the traditional Subak irrigation system. Afterward, join a nearby hands-on Balinese cooking class where you visit a local market, select fresh ingredients, and prepare dishes like nasi goreng, satay lilit, and lawar. This combined cultural and culinary experience is located just north of Ubud, making it easily accessible if staying in central Ubud. Scheduling this mid-trip (Days 3–8) ensures you are well-rested after arrival.

experiences.name: Yin Yoga & Sound Healing Retreat Day
experiences.description: Dedicate a full morning to a deeply restorative yin yoga and sound healing session at one of Ubud's renowned wellness centers such as The Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive. These studios are centrally located in Ubud and offer drop-in classes daily, making scheduling flexible throughout your 13-day stay. The sound healing component uses traditional Tibetan singing bowls and gamelan instruments, blending Balinese spiritual culture with modern wellness. This is ideal for mid-trip recovery days and pairs perfectly with a stay in central Ubud.

experiences.name: Nusa Dua Snorkeling & Beachside Seafood Lunch
experiences.description: Take a day trip to the calm, crystal-clear waters of Nusa Dua for a guided snorkeling excursion around vibrant coral reefs teeming with tropical fish. Nusa Dua is Bali's most sheltered beach area, making it ideal for calm-water activities. After snorkeling, enjoy a fresh seafood lunch at one of the beachside warungs, sampling grilled fish, prawns, and local sambal. This experience is best planned for the middle or latter part of your trip (Days 5–12) once you have settled in. Staying in Seminyak or Kuta keeps the transfer under 30 minutes.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Bali
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a pre-arranged budget shuttle or shared taxi from the airport to Ubud Boutique Stay (approx. 1.5–2 hrs, ~IDR 100,000–150,000). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle stroll along Jalan Monkey Forest to get oriented with the neighborhood.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the lively Ubud Night Market (Pasar Malam Ubud) on Jalan Raya Ubud. Browse local handicrafts, soak in the atmosphere, and enjoy your first taste of Balinese street food.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at the airport or a warung near the hotel upon arrival (Nasi Campur ~IDR 25,000)
meals.dinner: Ubud Night Market street food stalls — try Sate Lilit and Pisang Goreng (~IDR 30,000–50,000 total)

day_by_day.notes: Exchange some cash at the airport or a nearby money changer in Ubud. Avoid taxis that approach you inside the terminal — use official counters or pre-booked shuttles for better rates.

day_by_day.morning: Start the day with a free sunrise yoga session in the hotel garden or a community yoga class at one of Ubud's budget-friendly studios (e.g., Yoga Barn drop-in class ~IDR 120,000). Breathe in the cool morning air before the day heats up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk or rent a bicycle (~IDR 50,000/day) to explore the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terraces. Admission is free; small donations to local farmers are appreciated. The terraces are lush and green in July.
day_by_day.evening: Return to central Ubud and browse the Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni) for souvenirs before it closes. Watch a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud (~IDR 80,000).

meals.breakfast: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka or local warung near hotel — Nasi Goreng + tea (~IDR 25,000)
meals.lunch: Warung roadside near Tegallalang — Mie Goreng and fresh coconut (~IDR 35,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Teges or a local warung on Jalan Dewi Sita — Bebek Betutu or Gado-Gado (~IDR 40,000–60,000)

day_by_day.notes: Bicycle rental is a fantastic budget-friendly way to explore Ubud's surroundings. Carry water and sunscreen — July afternoons can be warm even at Ubud's elevation.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning hike to Campuhan Ridge Walk — a free, scenic trail starting just 10 minutes from central Ubud. Best enjoyed before 8:00 AM to avoid heat and crowds. The walk offers sweeping views of the jungle valley.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (~IDR 80,000 entry). Wander through the ancient temple grounds and observe the resident macaques. Spend the remaining afternoon relaxing at the hotel or reading in a café.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free or donation-based meditation session at a local wellness center. Then enjoy a quiet dinner at a budget warung.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl and coffee at a local café on Jalan Hanoman (~IDR 40,000)
meals.lunch: Warung near Monkey Forest — Nasi Campur and iced tea (~IDR 30,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Sopa (vegetarian-friendly) — set menu dinner (~IDR 50,000–70,000)

day_by_day.notes: Do not feed or tease the monkeys at the sanctuary — they can be aggressive. Keep bags zipped and sunglasses secured.

day_by_day.morning: Take a shared shuttle or rented scooter (~IDR 70,000/day) to Tirta Empul Temple in Tampaksiring (~30 min from Ubud). Participate in the sacred purification ritual in the holy spring pools (sarong required — free to borrow at entrance; entry ~IDR 50,000).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Gunung Kawi Temple complex nearby (~IDR 50,000 entry) — an 11th-century rock-cut shrine carved into a river gorge. Explore the carvings and lush surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud and relax with an affordable traditional Balinese massage (~IDR 80,000–100,000 for 60 min at local spas on Jalan Hanoman).

meals.breakfast: Local warung near hotel — banana pancakes and Bali coffee (~IDR 25,000)
meals.lunch: Warung near Tirta Empul — Nasi Goreng Ayam (~IDR 30,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah on Jalan Goutama — traditional Balinese cuisine (~IDR 50,000)

day_by_day.notes: Modest dress is required at both temples — shoulders and knees must be covered. Sarongs are available to borrow or rent at the entrance.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to the beach! Take a shared shuttle to Seminyak or Kuta Beach (~IDR 60,000–80,000 one way). Arrive by mid-morning for a swim and sunbathing session on the famous black-sand beach. July weather is perfect — warm and sunny.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stroll along the shoreline toward Echo Beach or rent a surfboard for a beginner lesson (~IDR 100,000–150,000 with instructor). The waves are consistent and beginner-friendly in July.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the legendary Kuta sunset from the beach — completely free and stunning. Then explore the Kuta area for cheap eats before catching a return shuttle to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Eat before departure — fruit and toast at hotel or a quick warung stop (~IDR 20,000)
meals.lunch: Warung or beachside warungs near Kuta — Nasi Campur and fresh juice (~IDR 40,000)
meals.dinner: Night market or warung in Kuta before heading back — Satay platter (~IDR 35,000)

day_by_day.notes: Book the return shuttle in advance from your hotel or a local travel agent to avoid being stranded. Swim between the red-and-yellow flags at Kuta — lifeguards are on duty.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Enjoy a slow start with yoga at Yoga Barn or a free online session in your room. Take a leisurely walk through Ubud's quieter back streets and visit a local temple ceremony if one is happening (free to observe respectfully).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum (~IDR 80,000) — a flamboyant artist's home-turned-gallery perched above the Campuhan River. Alternatively, browse free local art galleries along Jalan Raya Ubud.
day_by_day.evening: Cook or participate in a budget Balinese cooking class (~IDR 150,000–200,000 including market visit and 3-course meal) — a great value activity.

meals.breakfast: Café Lotus or a local warung — fruit platter, yogurt, and Bali coffee (~IDR 35,000)
meals.lunch: Light lunch included if doing cooking class, or a warung snack (~IDR 25,000)
meals.dinner: Enjoy the dishes you cooked in the cooking class, or a simple warung meal (~IDR 40,000)

day_by_day.notes: Many cooking classes include a morning market visit to Pasar Ubud — a great way to learn about local ingredients and interact with vendors.

day_by_day.morning: Early start for a sunrise trek to Mount Batur (Gunung Batur) — book a budget guided trek (~IDR 300,000–400,000 including guide and breakfast at the summit). Depart from Ubud around 2:00 AM to reach the trailhead by 3:30 AM and summit by sunrise (~5:30 AM).
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and soak in natural hot springs at the base of the volcano (~IDR 75,000). Return to Ubud by early afternoon and rest.
day_by_day.evening: Easy evening in Ubud — gentle walk, journaling at a café, or a restorative yoga class.

meals.breakfast: Included with the trek — boiled eggs and toast at the summit
meals.lunch: Warung near Kintamani on the way back — Nasi Goreng (~IDR 30,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Oka or a simple local warung — light meal to recover (~IDR 45,000)

day_by_day.notes: This is a physically demanding day — wear layers as the summit can be cold before sunrise. Book the trek through your hotel or a trusted local agent to get the best budget rate.

day_by_day.morning: Recovery morning after the trek. Sleep in, then enjoy a slow breakfast. Visit the Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — free to enter during the day — and admire the traditional Balinese royal architecture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a scooter and explore the scenic route to Pura Luhur Batukaru temple or the quieter villages of Penestanan and Sayan. Enjoy the rural landscapes and terraced fields away from tourist crowds.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud for a relaxing evening. Treat yourself to a budget foot reflexology session (~IDR 60,000 for 45 min).

meals.breakfast: Sleep in — brunch at a local café, avocado toast or Nasi Goreng (~IDR 35,000)
meals.lunch: Roadside warung during scooter exploration — local snacks and coconut water (~IDR 25,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Mendez or similar local spot — Babi Guling or vegetarian option (~IDR 50,000)

day_by_day.notes: Scooter rental is the most cost-effective way to explore the wider Ubud area. Ensure you have an international driving permit and always wear a helmet.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day to the south coast. Take a shared shuttle to Uluwatu (~IDR 80,000). Check in to a budget guesthouse or hostel near Uluwatu (~IDR 150,000–200,000/night). Head straight to Padang Padang Beach — a stunning pocket beach popular with surfers (~IDR 15,000 entry).
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on Padang Padang Beach, swim in the clear blue water, and watch surfers tackle the reef break. Walk the short coastal path to Impossibles Beach for a quieter spot.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Pura Luhur Uluwatu for the iconic clifftop Kecak Fire Dance at sunset (~IDR 100,000). The combination of the dramatic cliff setting, crashing waves, and fire dance is unforgettable.

meals.breakfast: Eat before departure from Ubud — warung breakfast (~IDR 25,000)
meals.lunch: Beach warung at Padang Padang — Nasi Campur and fresh juice (~IDR 40,000)
meals.dinner: Single Fin or a cheaper warung near Uluwatu — grilled fish or pasta (~IDR 60,000–80,000)

day_by_day.notes: Beware of monkeys at Uluwatu Temple — they are notorious for snatching glasses, hats, and phones. Keep belongings secure.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning yoga session on the cliffs or beach — many Uluwatu guesthouses offer free or cheap morning classes. Then head to Bingin Beach — a laid-back surfer beach accessible via steep steps, with stunning turquoise water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel or bodyboard at Bingin Beach (equipment rental ~IDR 50,000). Walk up to the clifftop warungs for a cold drink and panoramic views. Explore the hidden coves along the Bukit Peninsula.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Suluban Beach (Blue Point Beach) — free and spectacular. Dine at a clifftop warung as the sky turns orange and pink.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast or a small café near Bingin — eggs and toast (~IDR 30,000)
meals.lunch: Clifftop warung at Bingin — Mie Goreng and coconut (~IDR 35,000)
meals.dinner: Warung at Suluban Beach — grilled corn, satay, and fresh fruit juice (~IDR 50,000)

day_by_day.notes: The steps down to Bingin Beach are steep and uneven — wear proper sandals or shoes. Low tide reveals beautiful tidal pools worth exploring.

day_by_day.morning: Take a shared shuttle to Sanur (~IDR 60,000) and catch the fast boat to Nusa Penida (~IDR 150,000–200,000 return, 45 min crossing). Arrive and rent a scooter on the island (~IDR 80,000/day) to explore independently.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Kelingking Beach — the iconic T-Rex cliff viewpoint (free). The hike down to the beach is steep but rewarding with crystal-clear water and white sand. Also visit Crystal Bay for a swim and potential manta ray sighting.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Sanur by the last fast boat (~16:30). Take a shared shuttle back to your Uluwatu base or begin making your way toward the airport area if checking out the next day.

meals.breakfast: Quick warung breakfast before departure — Nasi Goreng (~IDR 25,000)
meals.lunch: Warung on Nusa Penida near Kelingking — simple local food (~IDR 35,000)
meals.dinner: Warung in Sanur after returning — fresh seafood or Nasi Campur (~IDR 50,000)

day_by_day.notes: The roads on Nusa Penida are rough and hilly — scooter experience is essential. Start early to maximize time on the island. Bring plenty of cash as ATMs are limited.

day_by_day.morning: Final full day — return to Ubud for a nostalgic last morning. Attend a sunrise yoga class at Yoga Barn or a rooftop studio (~IDR 120,000). Revisit your favorite spots — the rice terraces, Campuhan Ridge, or a quiet temple.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping at Ubud Art Market — bargain for batik fabrics, wooden carvings, and silver jewelry. Pack thoughtfully and check out if needed. Enjoy a final Balinese massage (~IDR 100,000).
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a slightly nicer warung or local restaurant — splurge slightly on your last night with a full Balinese feast. Reflect on the trip over a Bintang beer or fresh coconut.

meals.breakfast: Favorite café revisited — smoothie bowl and Bali coffee (~IDR 40,000)
meals.lunch: Warung on Jalan Dewi Sita — Nasi Campur and es campur dessert (~IDR 40,000)
meals.dinner: Locavore To Go or Warung Biah Biah — special farewell meal (~IDR 80,000–100,000)

day_by_day.notes: If your flight is early on Day 13, arrange an airport transfer the night before through your hotel (~IDR 150,000–200,000 shared shuttle). Confirm pickup time carefully.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Bali. Wake up early for one last sunrise or a quiet meditation session. Enjoy a simple breakfast, double-check your packing, and make your way to Ngurah Rai International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in and security.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure. Carry beautiful memories of Bali's beaches, temples, rice terraces, and yoga sessions.
day_by_day.evening: In transit home.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at hotel or a nearby warung — fruit, toast, and Bali coffee (~IDR 25,000)
meals.lunch: Airport food court or a final warung near the airport (~IDR 40,000–60,000)
meals.dinner: In-flight or at connecting airport

day_by_day.notes: Bali's airport can be busy — arrive early. Use up remaining Indonesian Rupiah on snacks, last-minute gifts at the airport shops, or donate to a local charity box. Safe travels!

trip_options.title: Classic Bali Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport transfer to Ubud Boutique Stay (~1.5 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle stroll along Monkey Forest Road to get oriented. Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary for a relaxed introduction to Ubud's spiritual atmosphere.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Ubud Night Market (Pasar Senggol) for local snacks and souvenirs. Enjoy a calm first evening settling in.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: Quick bite at a warung near the hotel after check-in — try nasi campur (mixed rice plate) for ~IDR 35,000
meals.dinner: Locavore To Go or Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka for a classic Balinese roast pork dish (~IDR 80,000–150,000)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — jet lag may be a factor. Hydrate well and rest early to prepare for the full days ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a sunrise yoga class at one of Ubud's renowned studios — Yoga Barn offers a 7:00 AM Hatha class with stunning jungle views (~USD 12). Follow with a healthy smoothie bowl at a nearby café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terraces (20 min from Ubud). Walk the paths through the lush green paddies and enjoy the landscape. Stop at a local craft market on the way back.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud (~IDR 100,000). A must-see cultural experience.

meals.breakfast: Sayuri Healing Food — organic smoothie bowl and herbal tea (~IDR 70,000)
meals.lunch: Warung Teges near Tegallalang — nasi goreng and fresh coconut (~IDR 50,000)
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali Restaurant — mid-range dining with river gorge views (~IDR 150,000–250,000 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Kecak performance in advance or arrive 30 minutes early to secure seats. Bring a light layer for the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Morning meditation and pranayama session at The Yoga Barn (7:30 AM). Afterward, visit Pura Tirta Empul — a sacred water temple where you can witness or participate in a purification ritual.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Gunung Kawi Temple complex, a stunning 11th-century rock-cut shrine surrounded by rice terraces. Allow 2 hours for the full site.
day_by_day.evening: Wander through Ubud Art Market and browse handmade textiles, jewelry, and woodcarvings. Pick up a souvenir or two.

meals.breakfast: Kafe Ubud — avocado toast and cold brew (~IDR 80,000)
meals.lunch: Warung near Gunung Kawi — gado-gado (peanut sauce salad) and fresh juice (~IDR 45,000)
meals.dinner: Naughty Nuri's Warung — famous BBQ ribs and cocktails (~IDR 150,000–200,000)

day_by_day.notes: Bring a sarong for temple visits — they are required for entry. Tirta Empul opens at 9:00 AM.

day_by_day.morning: Take a guided sunrise trek to Mount Batur (active volcano, ~1,717m). Depart from Ubud around 2:00 AM to reach the summit by sunrise (~5:30 AM). Breathtaking panoramic views over Lake Batur.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Ubud by midday. Soak tired muscles with a traditional Balinese massage at a local spa (~IDR 120,000 for 60 min).
day_by_day.evening: Low-key evening — rest, journal, or enjoy a gentle yin yoga class at Yoga Barn (5:30 PM).

meals.breakfast: Packed breakfast provided by the trek guide at the summit (usually eggs cooked in volcanic steam and hot tea)
meals.lunch: Clear Café Ubud — healthy bowls and fresh juices (~IDR 90,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah — homestyle Balinese cuisine in a cozy garden setting (~IDR 100,000)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Mount Batur trek through your hotel or a reputable agency the day before. Wear layers — it's cold at the summit (around 10°C). Bring a headlamp and sturdy shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Pura Besakih — the 'Mother Temple' of Bali, located on the slopes of Mount Agung (~1.5 hrs from Ubud). Arrive early to beat the crowds and experience the spiritual atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at Sidemen Valley on the return journey — a quieter, less-touristed rice terrace landscape perfect for a peaceful walk and photography.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Enjoy a Balinese cooking class in the evening (~USD 35–45) — learn to make satay, lawar, and black rice pudding.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or Kafe — full Balinese breakfast with rice porridge (bubur)
meals.lunch: Local warung in Sidemen — simple nasi campur with fresh tempeh (~IDR 40,000)
meals.dinner: Dishes made in your own cooking class — the best dinner of the trip!

day_by_day.notes: Hire a private driver for the Besakih-Sidemen loop (~IDR 350,000–450,000 for the day). A guide at Besakih is mandatory and costs ~IDR 150,000.

day_by_day.morning: Transfer day to the coast — head to Seminyak or Canggu (~1.5 hrs from Ubud). Check into a beach-area guesthouse or use the day as a day trip. Morning beach yoga session on the sand at Canggu's Echo Beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at Batu Bolong Beach — swimming, sunbathing, and watching surfers. The warm July weather (avg 25°C) is perfect for the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at La Brisa Beach Club — a stunning driftwood beach club with live music and cocktails. Watch the famous Bali sunset over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Milk & Madu Café in Canggu — eggs benedict and cold brew (~IDR 90,000)
meals.lunch: Nalu Bowls — acai bowls and fresh wraps at the beach (~IDR 75,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Dandelion — Indonesian and Western fusion near the beach (~IDR 120,000–180,000)

day_by_day.notes: If staying based in Ubud, this can be a full day trip with a driver. Alternatively, book a night or two at a mid-range beach guesthouse in Canggu (~USD 40–70/night).

day_by_day.morning: Morning surf lesson at Batu Bolong or Old Man's Beach, Canggu (~USD 25–35 for a 2-hour lesson with board rental). Ideal for beginners with gentle waves.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Seminyak's boutique shopping strip — browse local designers, handmade jewelry, and beachwear along Jalan Oberoi. Pick up unique gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Dinner and nightlife in Seminyak — vibrant yet relaxed vibe compared to Kuta. Enjoy cocktails at Ku De Ta or Potato Head Beach Club for a mid-range splurge.

meals.breakfast: Shelter Restaurant, Canggu — smoothie bowl and granola (~IDR 80,000)
meals.lunch: Betelnut Café, Seminyak — Thai-Indonesian fusion (~IDR 100,000–150,000)
meals.dinner: Sarong Restaurant — upscale Asian tapas in a beautiful open-air setting (~IDR 200,000–300,000 per person)

day_by_day.notes: July is dry season on the coast — minimal rain expected. Sunscreen and reef-safe products recommended for beach days.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Uluwatu — visit Pura Luhur Uluwatu, a dramatic sea temple perched on a 70m cliff. Arrive by 9:00 AM before the heat peaks. Watch for cheeky monkeys!
day_by_day.afternoon: Head down to Padang Padang Beach or Bingin Beach — two of Bali's most beautiful hidden beaches. Swim, snorkel, or simply relax on the white sand.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the sunset Kecak performance at Uluwatu Temple (6:00 PM, ~IDR 150,000) — arguably the most spectacular setting for this performance in all of Bali.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or grab nasi goreng from a local warung
meals.lunch: Single Fin Restaurant at Uluwatu — beachside burgers and salads with ocean views (~IDR 130,000–180,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Tulasi near Jimbaran — grilled seafood platter on the beach (~IDR 150,000–200,000)

day_by_day.notes: Hire a driver for the Uluwatu day trip (~IDR 400,000). The road to Padang Padang has steep stairs — wear comfortable shoes. Bring a sarong for the temple.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Ubud. Morning visit to Campuhan Ridge Walk — a peaceful 2km trail through lush jungle and open grasslands, best done early (7:00–9:00 AM) to avoid heat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Blanco Renaissance Museum — a flamboyant artist's home turned museum with stunning Balinese art collections. Followed by a browse of Ubud's gallery district.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Legong dance performance at Puri Saren Agung (Ubud Royal Palace) — held in the royal courtyard at 7:30 PM (~IDR 100,000).

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio — specialty coffee and pastries (~IDR 60,000)
meals.lunch: Tutmak Café — Indonesian classics with a view over a lotus pond (~IDR 80,000)
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant — fine dining with a tasting menu; a mid-range splurge night (~IDR 400,000–600,000 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Campuhan Ridge Walk is free and easily walkable from the hotel. Mozaic requires advance reservation — book 2–3 days ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day wellness day. Start with a 90-minute Balinese traditional massage and body scrub at Taksu Spa in Ubud (~IDR 250,000–350,000). Follow with a sound healing or chakra balancing session.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Ubud Botanic Garden or stroll through the Penestanan artists' village. Enjoy the calm, creative atmosphere and stop at local art studios.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset yoga at The Yoga Barn's outdoor platform (5:30 PM class). End the day with a nourishing plant-based dinner.

meals.breakfast: Alchemy Café — raw vegan breakfast bowl and superfood smoothie (~IDR 90,000)
meals.lunch: Earth Café & Market — organic salads, grain bowls, and herbal teas (~IDR 80,000)
meals.dinner: Sayuri Healing Food — fully plant-based tasting menu in a garden setting (~IDR 120,000)

day_by_day.notes: This is your dedicated rest and recharge day. Avoid planning anything strenuous. Book spa treatments in advance as Ubud spas fill up quickly in peak July season.

day_by_day.morning: White water rafting on the Ayung River — the most popular rafting route in Bali, passing through jungle gorges and past ancient carvings (~USD 35–45 including transfer and lunch).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Pura Taman Saraswati (Lotus Temple) in central Ubud — beautiful lotus ponds and intricate Balinese stonework. Quiet and photogenic in the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Take a batik or silver jewelry-making class in Ubud (~USD 20–30, 2 hours) — a fun hands-on cultural craft experience.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — fuel up for the rafting activity
meals.lunch: Included in the rafting package — usually a buffet at the riverside base camp
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Rai — beloved local spot for authentic Balinese food at great prices (~IDR 70,000–100,000)

day_by_day.notes: Rafting operators pick up from Ubud hotels. Wear clothes you don't mind getting wet. The Ayung River is Grade II–III — suitable for beginners and families.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to North Bali — visit the stunning Sekumpul Waterfall (the most beautiful in Bali). A moderate 45-minute hike through jungle leads to a series of cascading falls.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Lovina Beach for a quieter, black-sand coastal experience. Swim in calm waters (Lovina is sheltered from surf) and enjoy the relaxed northern vibe.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant with panoramic views over the rice fields.

meals.breakfast: Pack a light breakfast from the hotel or grab snacks for the road
meals.lunch: Warung near Sekumpul — simple Balinese lunch with fresh coconut (~IDR 50,000)
meals.dinner: Room4Dessert or Hujan Locale — creative Indonesian cuisine to celebrate the final full day (~IDR 200,000–300,000)

day_by_day.notes: Sekumpul requires a full-day private driver (~IDR 500,000–600,000). Wear sturdy shoes for the waterfall hike. Bring a waterproof bag for cameras. Depart Ubud by 6:30 AM to maximize the day.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise yoga session at The Yoga Barn or a gentle walk along Campuhan Ridge one last time. Pack up and check out of Ubud Boutique Stay.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on flight time — visit any last-minute spots in Ubud (art galleries, final souvenir shopping at Ubud Market). Transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport (~1.5 hrs from Ubud).
day_by_day.evening: Departure. Reflect on 13 incredible days of beaches, yoga, temples, and culture in Bali.

meals.breakfast: Final Balinese breakfast at the hotel — enjoy one last jaffles, fresh fruit, and Bali coffee
meals.lunch: Kafe or Clear Café before checkout — a light, healthy farewell meal (~IDR 80,000)
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or lounge dining depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for the transfer and check-in at Ngurah Rai Airport. Traffic from Ubud can be unpredictable — depart early. Consider purchasing last-minute items at the airport duty-free.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Bali Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Private airport transfer to Ubud Boutique Stay in Ubud (approx. 1.5–2 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and settle into your luxury villa. Take a leisurely stroll through the lush hotel gardens and enjoy a welcome drink at the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Gentle orientation walk through central Ubud — explore Jalan Raya Ubud, browse artisan boutiques, and soak in the vibrant atmosphere of the town at dusk.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in-flight meal
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Dinner at Locavore, Ubud — one of Bali's most celebrated fine-dining restaurants, offering a creative tasting menu using hyper-local ingredients. Reservation recommended well in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private airport transfer in advance through your hotel concierge. Carry a light layer for the air-conditioned vehicle. Jet lag may set in — keep the evening relaxed.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session at your hotel or a nearby premium yoga studio such as The Yoga Barn (open-air pavilion, world-class instructors). Follow with a nourishing post-yoga smoothie bowl at the studio café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided tour of the iconic Tegalalang Rice Terraces — explore the UNESCO-listed subak irrigation system, walk the terraced paths, and enjoy panoramic views. Continue to Tirta Empul Temple for a cultural immersion and optional purification ritual.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the hotel for a sunset spa treatment — indulge in a traditional Balinese massage or a floral bath ritual at the hotel's luxury spa.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel — tropical fruit platters, freshly baked pastries, and Balinese coffee.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Swept Away at COMO Shambhala Estate — elegant riverside dining with organic, health-focused cuisine.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique — award-winning French-Asian fusion tasting menu in a romantic garden setting.

day_by_day.notes: Book yoga session and Mozaic dinner in advance. Wear comfortable walking shoes for the rice terraces. Sarong required at the temple (usually available for rent on-site).

day_by_day.morning: Private Balinese cooking class at a premium culinary school (e.g., Paon Bali Cooking Class or Casa Luna Cooking School) — visit a local market, learn to prepare traditional dishes, and enjoy your creations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Ubud Royal Palace (Puri Saren Agung) and the nearby Ubud Art Market for curated artisan shopping — batik, silver jewelry, and handcrafted woodwork.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud or Uluwatu-style staging near Ubud — a mesmerizing cultural spectacle at sunset.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel — Nasi Goreng, fresh tropical juices, and Balinese herbal tea.
meals.lunch: Enjoy the dishes prepared during your cooking class.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Hujan Locale — contemporary Indonesian cuisine in a sophisticated colonial-era setting.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm cooking class booking 48 hours in advance. The Kecak performance typically begins at 18:30 — arrive 20 minutes early for good seating.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga and meditation session overlooking the Campuhan Ridge — a serene hilltop walk followed by guided breathwork with a certified instructor.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private art studio tour of Ubud's renowned galleries — visit Neka Art Museum and ARMA (Agung Rai Museum of Art) to explore Balinese and Indonesian fine art collections.
day_by_day.evening: Luxurious in-hotel evening — enjoy cocktails at the hotel bar followed by a private candlelit dinner arranged by the concierge in your villa garden.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel — avocado toast, poached eggs, fresh-pressed juices.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Bridges Bali — stunning gorge-view restaurant with international and Balinese cuisine.
meals.dinner: Private in-villa candlelit dinner curated by the hotel chef — customized menu with local ingredients.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange the in-villa dinner with the hotel concierge at least one day ahead. Campuhan Ridge walk is best done before 8:00 AM to avoid heat.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to Mount Batur — private guided sunrise trek to the active volcano (depart hotel by 02:00 AM). Watch the sunrise from the 1,717m summit with panoramic views over Lake Batur.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and visit natural hot springs at Toya Bungkah for a rejuvenating soak. Explore the lakeside village of Trunyan.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud in the late afternoon. Unwind with a 90-minute deep tissue or hot stone massage at the hotel spa.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-trek snack box prepared by the hotel (banana, energy bar, water).
meals.lunch: Lunch at a lakeside warung near Kintamani — grilled fish, local vegetables, and coconut water with panoramic caldera views.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Room4Dessert — avant-garde dessert-forward tasting menu by world-renowned pastry chef Will Goldfarb.

day_by_day.notes: The volcano trek requires an early 02:00 AM departure — rest well the day before. Bring warm layers, a headlamp, and sturdy hiking shoes. Book a licensed guide through the hotel concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning — gentle restorative yoga session at the hotel, followed by a leisurely breakfast. Optional: Ayurvedic consultation at the hotel spa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private transfer to the coastal area of Seminyak or Canggu (approx. 1.5 hrs) for an afternoon beach experience — relax at a premium beach club such as Potato Head Beach Club or La Brisa.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the beach club with live acoustic music. Explore Seminyak's boutique shopping strip — Deus Ex Machina, Biasa, and Indivie for curated Bali fashion.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast at the hotel — full Balinese spread with jamu wellness shots.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Métis Restaurant & Gallery, Seminyak — refined French-Mediterranean cuisine in a stunning colonial villa.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Sarong Restaurant, Seminyak — sophisticated Pan-Asian tasting menu in an opulent setting.

day_by_day.notes: Book beach club day beds in advance — they fill quickly in peak season. Return transfer to Ubud arranged for approximately 22:00.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga session on a clifftop or rice terrace platform — arranged by the hotel for an exclusive outdoor experience. Follow with a wellness breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Penglipuran Traditional Village — one of Bali's cleanest and most pristine traditional Balinese villages, offering an authentic cultural experience with bamboo forest walks.
day_by_day.evening: Visit Pura Besakih, the 'Mother Temple' of Bali on the slopes of Mount Agung — the most sacred temple complex on the island. Enjoy the mystical atmosphere at dusk.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the hotel — açaí bowls, chia pudding, herbal elixirs.
meals.lunch: Lunch at a premium warung near Penglipuran — traditional Balinese babi guling (suckling pig) or vegetarian lawar.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Alaya Resort Ubud's Plantation Restaurant — refined Balinese cuisine with garden views.

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for temple visits — covered shoulders and a sarong are mandatory. The hotel can arrange sarong rental. Besakih Temple is about 1.5 hrs from Ubud.

day_by_day.morning: Private surf lesson or stand-up paddleboard (SUP) session at Keramas Beach or Padang Padang (day trip from Ubud, approx. 1 hr). Keramas offers world-class waves and a premium surf club experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax on the black sand beach at Keramas, enjoy beach massages, and explore the coastal scenery. Visit the nearby Goa Lawah Bat Temple.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Enjoy a private Balinese Ratus (royal floral steam) and herbal body wrap at the hotel spa.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel — eggs Benedict, tropical fruit, fresh coconut.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Komune Resort Beach Club, Keramas — stylish beachfront dining with fresh seafood and healthy bowls.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Kafe Ubud — vibrant, health-conscious menu with live music.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm surf lesson booking in advance. Beginners are welcome at Padang Padang; intermediate surfers will enjoy Keramas. Bring reef-safe sunscreen.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day private excursion to Nusa Penida Island — take a private speedboat from Sanur (depart 08:00, approx. 45 min). Visit the iconic Kelingking Beach (T-Rex cliff viewpoint) and Angel's Billabong.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel at Crystal Bay — one of Bali's premier snorkeling spots with vibrant coral reefs and potential manta ray sightings. Relax on the pristine white sand beach.
day_by_day.evening: Return speedboat to Sanur (approx. 17:00). Private transfer back to Ubud. Enjoy a quiet evening at the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel — grab-and-go style with pastries and coffee.
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood lunch at a beachside warung on Nusa Penida — grilled fish, sambal, and coconut rice.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Kubu Restaurant at Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve — extraordinary dining inside a bamboo cocoon over a river gorge.

day_by_day.notes: Book Kubu Restaurant well in advance — one of Bali's most exclusive dining experiences. Wear water shoes for rocky beach entry on Nusa Penida. Bring waterproof bags for snorkeling gear.

day_by_day.morning: Luxury wellness morning — private two-hour Balinese Boreh (traditional spice scrub) and chakra balancing massage at the hotel spa. Follow with a meditation session in the hotel garden.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private silversmithing or batik-making workshop in Ubud — create a bespoke piece of jewelry or hand-dyed fabric with a master artisan.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at Ku De Ta (or similar premium rooftop bar with arrangements from Ubud) or enjoy the hotel's curated cocktail hour with live gamelan music.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast in bed — hotel room service with a full Balinese breakfast set.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Sari Organik — farm-to-table restaurant set amid rice paddies, accessible via a scenic walk through the fields.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Blanco Par Mandif — intimate fine dining with a bold, artistic tasting menu by Chef Mandif Warokka.

day_by_day.notes: This is a designated slower-paced day for rest and rejuvenation. Sari Organik is a 20-minute walk through rice fields — wear comfortable footwear.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga and pranayama session at Campuhan Ridge or a secluded rice terrace — guided by a senior yoga teacher with 90 minutes of practice followed by silent meditation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Day trip to Tanah Lot Temple — one of Bali's most iconic sea temples perched on a rocky outcrop. Explore the surrounding cliffs and sea caves at low tide.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset viewing at Tanah Lot — the temple is world-famous for its dramatic sunset backdrop. Return to Ubud for a relaxed evening.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga wellness breakfast at the hotel — green smoothies, granola, and local cheeses.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Cepaka Restaurant near Tanah Lot — elevated Balinese and international cuisine with ocean views.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Barbacoa, Ubud — premium wood-fired meats and innovative cocktails in a sophisticated setting.

day_by_day.notes: Tanah Lot is approximately 1.5 hours from Ubud. Arrive at the temple by 16:00 to secure a good sunset vantage point. Modest dress required.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided white-water rafting experience on the Ayung River — Bali's most scenic rafting route through jungle gorges and past ancient stone carvings (premium operator: Mason Adventures or Sobek).
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-rafting luxury recovery — return to the hotel for a private poolside afternoon with personalized butler service, tropical cocktails, and a curated cheese and charcuterie board.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell cultural evening — attend a premium private Legong dance performance arranged by the hotel, followed by a special farewell dinner.

meals.breakfast: Hearty breakfast at the hotel — full protein spread to prepare for the rafting adventure.
meals.lunch: Post-rafting lunch included with premium rafting package — traditional Balinese buffet at the rafting company's riverside pavilion.
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at Locavore NXT (the casual sister of Locavore) or a return visit to your favorite restaurant — celebrate with a curated wine pairing menu.

day_by_day.notes: Book rafting with a premium operator for the best safety standards and experience. The Ayung River is suitable for all levels. Bring a change of clothes and a waterproof bag.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise yoga session on the hotel terrace — a mindful closing practice to integrate the journey. Pack and prepare for departure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute artisan shopping in Ubud — pick up premium Balinese crafts, organic beauty products (Sensatia Botanicals), or custom silver jewelry as souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Private transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport for departure flight. Arrive at the airport at least 3 hours before international departure.

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at the hotel — leisurely and indulgent, with the full hotel menu at your disposal.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at Café Wayan or Melting Wok Warung — a relaxed farewell to Ubud's culinary scene.
meals.dinner: Airport lounge dining or an early dinner before departure at a premium restaurant near the airport in Kuta/Seminyak if time permits.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm checkout time with the hotel — many luxury properties offer late checkout upon request. Arrange airport transfer the evening before. Reconfirm return flight details with your airline.
